=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/targeted_file_context.py: normalize_path() at lines 241-245; is_sensitive_target_path() removed (was at lines 155-167) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: The sensitive-path guard rejecting repository credential and metadata paths was deleted.
  WHY: Untrusted paths such as `.git/config`, `.env*`, `.ssh/*`, and `.aws/*` are resolved and read into model-visible context, exposing credentials and Git metadata.

- scripts/ai_memory_lib.py: _inject_token_into_url() at lines 3038-3055; _resolve_origin_url() at lines 3074-3087 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: GH_TOKEN is embedded directly into HTTPS Git URLs instead of being supplied through ephemeral authentication headers.
  WHY: The PAT appears in process arguments, Git remote configuration, Git diagnostics, exception text, and workflow logs.

- scripts/memory_helpers.sh: _memory_force_tick_remote_url() at lines 581-585; callers at lines 601, 624, 767, 883, 919 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Force-tick Git URLs embed the GitHub token and are passed to Git subprocesses.
  WHY: The PAT is exposed in argv, cloned remote configuration, and Git stderr, while the prior authenticated helper was removed.

- scripts/memory_helpers.sh: lines 130-188; memory_ensure_branch() at lines 140, 151, 180 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: `memory_ensure_branch` assigns a token but performs branch probes and pushes with bare unauthenticated Git commands.
  WHY: With `persist-credentials: false`, branch discovery and creation fail authentication and the fail-open path silently disables the memory subsystem.

- scripts/write_codex_config.sh: while-case at lines 99-114 (--provider-base-url case removed); callers at scripts/codex_helpers.sh lines 373, 395 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: `--provider-base-url` was removed from the parser while brokered Codex callers still pass it.
  WHY: Configuration generation exits on an unknown argument before writing `config.toml`, preventing brokered Codex invocations from starting and leaving the intended broker base URL unavailable.

- scripts/gh_helpers.sh: review_blocked_* helpers removed (was approximately lines 972-1377) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Shared review-blocked approval and successor helpers were deleted while the poller, judge, and tests still invoke them.
  WHY: Approval requests, pending-approval detection, status checks, consumed markers, and successor handling are skipped or fail, causing review-blocked workflows to stall.

- scripts/review_rb_judge.sh: line 2014 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: The judge directly calls the deleted `git_with_github_auth` helper when pushing a `[judge-fix]` commit.
  WHY: The push reaches `command not found`, leaving the fix local and preventing the review-blocked PR from advancing.

- scripts/gh_helpers.sh: _gh_pr_with_all_comments_rest() at line 780; gh_pr_with_all_comments() GraphQL jq at line 934 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Comment payloads no longer include `id`, `author_id`, `author_type`, or `author_association`.
  WHY: Thread-resolution consumers receive null IDs and trusted-producer/refusal checks cannot identify the producer, so comment resolution and refusal protection fail.

- scripts/targeted_file_context.py: lines 540-547 (`for rel in paths:`); removal of constants `MAX_TARGET_PATHS = 256` and `MAX_TARGET_PATH_BYTES = 1024` | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: The path-count and per-path byte limits were removed, and missing-path markers are not charged against the output budget.
  WHY: An untrusted path list can generate thousands of markers or oversized file content, exhausting the prompt or Codex stdin budget.

- tests/test_targeted_file_context.py: lines 29-37 (imports of MAX_TARGET_PATHS and is_sensitive_target_path) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: The test module still imports symbols deleted from `targeted_file_context`.
  WHY: Pytest raises `ImportError` during collection, blocking the test suite before tests execute.

- scripts/targeted_file_context.py: emit_context() at lines 562-564 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: `max_bytes <= 0` returns a header and disabled marker instead of an empty string.
  WHY: Callers that use zero to disable targeted context receive unintended prompt content, and `test_disabled_by_zero_max_bytes` fails.

- scripts/implement_commit_changes.sh: line 62 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: The `pre_assembled_static.txt` existence check changed from testing `HEAD` to testing the index or working tree.
  WHY: Cleanup can remove or restore the wrong version of a file that exists at `HEAD`, changing the preservation contract.

- scripts/codex_helpers.sh: model_provider_broker_start() at lines 163-172 | severity=high | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: Broker startup rejects an empty `MODEL_PROVIDER_BROKER_ALLOWED_MODELS` and `MODEL_EDITOR` fallback.

- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml: post-merge-validate-dispatch job lines 893-920; post-merge-force-poll job lines 1043-1080 | severity=critical | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, mistralai_mistral-small-2603]
